shortDescription: Indonesia posted a budget deficit of 240.1 trillion rupiah ($13.55 billion) in the first eight months of 2026, equivalent to 0.93% of gross domestic product, its new Finance Minister Suahasil Nazara said on Friday.($1 = 17,725.0000 rupiah)
